# Davidson Day School — Branding — Athletics Logo

**Provenance:** Fetched by Claude on 2026-07-25 via web research, to add the school's
athletics mascot logo to the school-page header in the app.

- **School:** Davidson Day School (Davidson, NC)
- **Mascot / teams:** Patriots
- **Athletic colors:** Red, white & navy
- **Logo used in app:** `public/logos/davidson-day.png` — primary Patriots mark: an
 interlocking red "DD" monogram with navy outline. 1200×800 PNG, transparent background.
